title: The scalar restriction of the etale-origin projection square for a qcqs morphism
statement: Let A→B be a map φ of finite commutative rings and p:Z→Y a qcqs morphism. In the canonical notation H,q,b,π_e of [def-fix-proper-etale-origin-scalar-data], take E in D⁺(Z_et,A) and assume H(E) is bounded below. Let χ:S_Y P_A→P_B S_Z be the specified intrinsic B-linear counit mate and d:U_Y P_B≅P_A U_Z the canonical restriction/direct-image isomorphism [lem-fix-proetale-scalar-mate-normalization, lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction]. The following inverse-free square commutes: q_(R_e E) followed by US(b_E), U(χ_(F_Z E)), and d_(S_Z F_Z E) equals F_Y(π_e) followed by b_(H E) and P_A(q_E). This is an equality of the specified maps. No properness, flatness, finite Tor dimension or invertibility of a projection morphism is asserted.

proof.text: Use originMate_app to identify each specified bounded-below direct-image isomorphism with its canonical ambient mate. The helper originMate_counit supplies its geometric counit identity, including the intrinsic realization factors.

Apply the ring-sheaf change adjunction formula to the B-geometric counit. After applying the inverse A-adjunction Hom equivalence it identifies the counit transpose of scalarMateRestrictionPush. Compose with the defining scalar-extension mate counit identity and use naturality of the restriction/pullback comparison. This proves scalar_counit, identifying the restricted scalar comparison composite with the mate of originScalarPullback.

Compute the counit transpose of properOriginEtaleProjection from the published projection arrow. Tensor naturality moves the constant-coefficient pullback identification past the counit, giving originEtaleTensorPullback followed by tensor of the etale counit.

Specialize the local scalar/tensor pullback square to C=R_e(E). Transpose both sides of the claimed direct-image square under the intrinsic A-geometric adjunction. Use the two counit calculations, then the local square, naturality of originTensorComparison at the etale counit, and naturality of originPullback at properOriginEtaleProjection. The two transposes coincide. Injectivity of the Hom equivalence proves the original equation. Only the supplied bounds on E and H are used to identify the included mates.

theorem etaleOriginScalarProjectionSquare
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : Z ⟶ Y)
    [QuasiCompact p] [QuasiSeparated p]
    (E : DerivedCategory.Plus
      (Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A))))
    (hH : ∃ n : ℤ,
      (properOriginEtaleTensor (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ) Z E.obj).IsGE n) :
    (properOriginTensorIso φ Y
        ((Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) p).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
          E.obj)).hom ≫
      (directImageScalarExtension φ Y ⋙ (scalarMateRestriction φ Y).mapDerivedCategory).map
        (properOriginMateIso A p E).hom ≫
      (scalarMateRestriction φ Y).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((directImageScalarComparison φ p).app
          ((finiteCoefficientIntrinsicDerivedComparison Z A).obj E.obj)) ≫
      (scalarMateRestrictionPush φ p).hom.app
        ((directImageScalarExtension φ Z).obj
          ((finiteCoefficientIntrinsicDerivedComparison Z A).obj E.obj)) =
    (finiteCoefficientIntrinsicDerivedComparison Y A).map
        (properOriginEtaleProjection (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ) p E.obj) ≫
      (properOriginMateIso A p
        ⟨properOriginEtaleTensor (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ) Z E.obj, hH⟩).hom ≫
      (directImageConstantPush A p).map (properOriginTensorIso φ Z E.obj).hom
